docs: make comments rationale-only, and cut the ones that are not (#113)

* docs: make comments rationale-only, and cut the ones that are not

AGENTS.md gains a "Comments are rationale, and they are short" section naming
the four shapes that do not belong in a source file: arguments against an
alternative, investigation write-ups, citations to another repo's files, and
restatement. It also names the length: two lines normal, four long, a
paragraph a bug.

Then the sweep. Twenty-odd blocks across src/, tests/e2e/, the firewall
script and the workflow YAML lose everything but the constraint a future
editor would otherwise break. Nothing that survives is new; each one is the
same fact at a tenth the length.

The `DEFERRED:` note in config.py about vet-on-exit is now #112, per
"Now over later".

Fixes #111

* e2e attestation for chore/trim-comments

+## Comments are rationale, and they are short
+
+A comment earns its place only when the reason is not derivable from the code:
+a constraint, a workaround, a decision that looks wrong until you know why.
+Two lines is a normal length. Four is long. A paragraph is a bug.
+
+The failure mode here is specific, and it is an agent failure mode. Reasoning
+that felt load-bearing while the change was being made gets committed next to
+the code, and the file accumulates an essay nobody asked for. Concretely, none
+of these belong in a source file:

+  moves.

+

+who wants the history can run `git blame`.

+start it at all" is worth keeping, because deleting it invites someone to

+issue (see *Now over later*).

          enable-cache: true
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        name: Provision the Python suite environment (uv)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PYTHON_ENV: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.python_env || 'pip' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PYTHON_ENV" = "uv" ]; then uv sync; else uv venv; fi
          if compgen -G "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hermetic-cli/*.whl" > /dev/null; then uv pip install pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/hermetic-cli/*.whl; else uv pip install pytest testing-conventions; fi
          echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript'
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      - if: needs.detect.outputs.build_command != ''
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - name: Check changed-line coverage vs ${{ inputs.base }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit coverage --language "$LANGUAGE" --base "$BASE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"

  mutation:
    name: Unit mutation — changed lines (${{ matrix.language }})
    needs: detect
    # `mutation_languages` is a newer detect output, so the matrix falls back to
    # `coverage_languages` (the identical set) until `@v0` advances to a detect that emits it.
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"mutation"')) && (needs.detect.outputs.mutation_languages || needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.mutation_languages || needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # `--base` diffs `<base>...HEAD`, so the base ref must be reachable.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: a maturin/PyO3 build triggered by `uv sync` needs it.
      - if: (inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') && matrix.language != 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true'
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        name: Provision the Python suite environment (uv)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PYTHON_ENV: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.python_env || 'pip' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PYTHON_ENV" = "uv" ]; then uv sync; else uv venv; fi
          if compgen -G "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hermetic-cli/*.whl" > /dev/null; then uv pip install pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/hermetic-cli/*.whl; else uv pip install pytest testing-conventions; fi
          echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript'
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      # The CLI installs cargo-mutants itself on first use; caching that dir reuses the build.
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        name: Cache the provisioned cargo-mutants
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/testing-conventions
          key: cargo-mutants-provision-${{ runner.os }}
      - if: needs.detect.outputs.build_command != ''
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - name: Check mutation on the lines changed vs ${{ inputs.base }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
          # `$TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS` is deliberately unquoted: empty on the published path,
          # word-split into flag and path on the hermetic one.
          TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_mutation_adapter_args }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit mutation --language "$LANGUAGE" --base "$BASE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH" $TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS

  e2e-verify:
    name: E2E attestation freshness (e2e verify)
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"e2e-verify"')) && (inputs.run_e2e || needs.detect.outputs.e2e_attestation == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # `--base` diffs `<base>..HEAD`, so full history is needed and `inputs.base` must resolve.
          # Check out the PR's head commit, not the ephemeral merge commit, which an attestation
          # can never name — it is rebuilt on every push.
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      - name: Verify the e2e attestation is current
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          PACKAGE_ROOT: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          EXTRA_SCOPE: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.e2e_extra_scope }}
          EXCLUDE: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.e2e_exclude }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        # `$EXTRA_SCOPE` / `$EXCLUDE` are deliberately unquoted: empty expands to nothing, and a
        # rendered value word-splits into the repeated flags.
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} e2e verify "$PACKAGE_ROOT" --scope "$SCAN_PATH" --base "$BASE" $EXTRA_SCOPE $EXCLUDE

  packaging:
    name: Packaging (no test files in the built artifact)
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"packaging"')) && (inputs.packaging_artifact != '' || needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' || needs.detect.outputs.packaging_dist == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Checkout must precede the artifact download: actions/checkout deletes the workspace's
      # existing contents before initializing, so downloading first would wipe the artifact.
      - name: Check out the repository to build/inspect its distribution, or just to resolve the hermetic-cli download action
        if: inputs.packaging_artifact == '' || needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Download the uploaded distributions
        if: inputs.packaging_artifact != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact }}
          path: _packaging_artifact
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: `cargo package` needs it, and `uv build`/`prepack` may compile a Rust core.
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && (needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'rust' || inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && (needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'rust' || inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') }}
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'python' }}
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm' }}
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'typescript' }}
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && needs.detect.outputs.build_command != '' }}
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' }}
        name: Build the distribution (packaging_build)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PACKAGING_BUILD: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$PACKAGING_BUILD"
      - name: Check the built distributions ship no test files
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          PACKAGING_ARTIFACT: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact }}
          PACKAGE_ROOT: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # nullglob: an unmatched glob expands to nothing, not the literal; globstar: `**` recurses.
          shopt -s nullglob globstar
          pkg="${PACKAGE_ROOT:-.}"
          if [ -n "$PACKAGING_ARTIFACT" ]; then dist_root=_packaging_artifact; crate_root=_packaging_artifact; else dist_root="$pkg/dist"; crate_root="$pkg/target/package"; fi
          checked=0
          check () {
            local lang="$1"; shift
            for dist in "$@"; do
              echo "::group::packaging --language $lang $dist"
              ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} packaging "$dist" --language "$lang"
              echo "::endgroup::"
              checked=$((checked + 1))
            done
          }
          check python "$dist_root"/**/*.whl "$dist_root"/**/*.tar.gz
          check typescript "$dist_root"/**/*.tgz
          check rust "$crate_root"/**/*.crate
          if [ "$checked" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::no recognized built distribution (.whl / .tar.gz / .tgz / .crate) found in '$dist_root' or '$crate_root'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "checked $checked built distribution(s); no test files shipped"

name: Build and Push Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.devcontainer/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-cage-image.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.devcontainer/**'
      - '.github/workflows/publish-cage-image.yml'
  schedule:
    # Weekly on Sunday at midnight UTC - keeps GitHub Actions cache warm
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      claude_code_version:
        description: 'Claude Code version to install'
        required: false
        default: 'latest'

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: linux/amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
          - platform: linux/arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU (for cross-platform builds)
        if: matrix.platform != 'linux/arm64' || matrix.runner != 'ubuntu-24.04-arm'
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract platform name
        id: platform
        run: echo "name=${PLATFORM//\//-}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels)
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}

      - name: Calculate Dockerfile hash
        id: dockerfile-hash
        run: echo "hash=$(sha256sum .devcontainer/Dockerfile | cut -c1-8)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get build timestamp
        id: timestamp
        run: echo "value=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build and push by digest
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .devcontainer
          file: .devcontainer/Dockerfile
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          build-args: |
            CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=${{ inputs.claude_code_version || 'latest' }}
            BUILD_TIMESTAMP=${{ steps.timestamp.outputs.value }}
            BUILD_SOURCE=ghcr.io
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ steps.platform.outputs.name }}-${{ steps.dockerfile-hash.outputs.hash }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ steps.platform.outputs.name }}-${{ steps.dockerfile-hash.outputs.hash }}
          outputs: type=image,name=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}

      - name: Export digest
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/digests
          digest="${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}"
          touch "/tmp/digests/${digest#sha256:}"

      - name: Upload digest
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: digests-${{ steps.platform.outputs.name }}
          path: /tmp/digests/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: build
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Download digests
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/digests
          pattern: digests-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels)
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=sha,prefix=

      - name: Create manifest list and push
        working-directory: /tmp/digests
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create $(jq -cr '.tags | map("-t " + .) | join(" ")' <<< "$DOCKER_METADATA_OUTPUT_JSON") \
            $(printf '${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}@sha256:%s ' *)

      - name: Inspect image
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest

name: Release


on:

jobs:

    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/release.yml@v0

    steps:

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:

name: Test CLI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      # Deps this lane installs via `uv sync`, plus [tool.pytest.ini_options]
      # (the unit/integration marker config both jobs select on).
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/test-cli.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/test-cli.yml'

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Install project + dev dependencies
        run: uv sync --python 3.12

      - name: Run unit tests
        # Unit tier: colocated next to source (src/**/*_test.py), marked `unit`.
        run: uv run pytest src -m unit

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4

      - name: Install project + dev dependencies
        run: uv sync --python 3.12

      - name: Run integration tests
        # Integration tier (tests/integration), marked `integration`: first-party
        # code runs for real against the host filesystem/env; collaborators
        # (Docker, subprocess, network) are mocked, so no container is needed.
        run: uv run pytest tests/integration -m integration

name: Test Container

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.devcontainer/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-container.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.devcontainer/**'
      - '.github/workflows/test-container.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build test image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .devcontainer
          file: .devcontainer/Dockerfile
          load: true
          tags: lamp-the-djinn-test:latest

      - name: Test - uv is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest uv --version

      - name: Test - uvx is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest uvx --version

      - name: Test - pnpm is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest pnpm --version

      - name: Test - npm is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest npm --version

      - name: Test - node is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest node --version

      - name: Test - claude is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest claude --version

      - name: Test - git is installed
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest git --version

      - name: Test - firewall scripts exist
        run: |
          docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest ls -la /usr/local/bin/init-firewall.sh
          docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest ls -la /usr/local/bin/add-domain-to-firewall.sh
          docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest ls -la /usr/local/bin/safe-rm

      - name: Test - GPG setup script exists
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest ls -la /usr/local/bin/setup-gpg.sh

      - name: Test - whitelisted domains file exists
        run: docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest cat /usr/local/share/whitelisted-domains.txt | head -20

      - name: Test - runs as non-root user
        run: |
          USER=$(docker run --rm lamp-the-djinn-test:latest whoami)
          if [ "$USER" != "node" ]; then
            echo "Expected user 'node', got '$USER'"
            exit 1
          fi
